speed.comment: Falling speed range for columns (pixels per frame). Higher values = faster falling.

animation.comment: Animation frames per second. Higher values = smoother but more CPU intensive.

column.comment: Minimum and maximum length of each falling column (number of characters).

font.name: Consolas
font.comment: Font name and size for the matrix characters.
